screens.heading: The $100,000 Financial Crossroads
screens.body: Before signing a loan document that impacts your next twenty years, let's run the actual math. You will pick a career path, input actual university costs, and witness the real age-30 net budget outcome.

screens.prompt: Step 1: Choose your Academic Field of Study (Establishes your estimated future earning bracket and career joy):

options.text: STEM (Software/Engineering) | Base Joy: +15 | Avg Starting Pay: $78,000
Fine Arts / Humanities / Design | Base Joy: +60 | Avg Starting Pay: $42,000
Nursing / Healthcare Ops | Base Joy: +35 | Avg Starting Pay: $70,000
Business / Finance / Accounting | Base Joy: +10 | Avg Starting Pay: $65,000

screens.prompt: Step 2: Input the actual numbers for the university track you want to evaluate. (Use yearly estimations based on your financial aid award letters or research):

inputs.label: Annual Housing & Living Overhead ($ per year)
Annual Scholarships, Grants, or Family Help ($ per year)

screens.prompt: Step 3: Funding Strategy. Drag the slider to determine what percentage of your leftover funding gap will be covered by Student Loans versus working part-time:

slider.label: Percentage of Leftover Deficit Paid via Student Loans
